patterns.note: Massive, ultra-condensed uppercase display typography that acts as a structural layout element, often overlapping with images.
Asymmetrical, staggered grid layouts with generous whitespace, allowing large media blocks and text to breathe.
A high-contrast dual-theme system featuring a pitch-black homepage and a stark-white interior page, unified by a vibrant electric blue accent.
Multi-layered parallax scrolling where giant background text moves at a slower rate than foreground image cards, creating depth.
Staggered, numbered step-by-step lists with clean horizontal dividers to break down processes and benefits.

technique_notes: Recreate the motion system using GSAP ScrollTrigger to bind the Y-axis translation of background text elements to the scroll position, creating a subtle parallax lag behind the foreground images.

Implement a seamless page transition system (such as Barba.js) that triggers a full-screen solid black curtain fade-out and fade-in to elegantly bridge the dark-themed homepage and light-themed interior pages.
Use CSS Grid with overlapping grid lines and z-index layering to position massive display headings behind image containers without breaking responsive document flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extreme contrast between screen-filling, ultra-bold display headings and small, highly legible, widely-spaced body copy.

standout: The design is distinguished by its dramatic transition from a pitch-black homepage to a stark-white interior culture page, held together by colossal, screen-spanning typography that functions more like architectural pillars than standard copy.
